name: host_ssh_revoke_old_grants
sql: UPDATE permission_grants SET revoked_at = now(), revoked_by = 'migration:host-ssh' WHERE kind = 'ssh-repair' AND revoked_at IS NULL;

name: repair_job_result_arrays
sql: UPDATE jobs SET result = (SELECT element FROM jsonb_array_elements(result) WITH ORDINALITY AS items(element, position) WHERE jsonb_typeof(element) = 'object' ORDER BY position DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE jsonb_typeof(result) = 'array';

name: jobs_result_object_only
sql:
UPDATE jobs SET result = NULL WHERE jsonb_typeof(result) NOT IN ('object', 'null');
ALTER TABLE jobs ADD CONSTRAINT jobs_result_object_only CHECK (result IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(result) IN ('object', 'null'));
